items.why: Truist raised its price target to 1000 from 763, citing optimism around the Muse Wonder AI model and upcoming results.
Stocks slipped as earnings season kicked off with bank results and a tech selloff, lifting demand for protection.
Bitcoin bounced back above 83000 after dipping below 81000 overnight as a Korean chip selloff weighed on risk appetite.
Apple unveiled its HomeView smart home hub, and JPMorgan raised its price target to 360 from 340 on holiday quarter optimism.

market_note: S&P, Nasdaq and Dow futures were all slightly lower at midday.
summary: Stocks were mixed and mostly lower at midday as earnings season kicked off, with bank results driving rotation out of tech and into other sectors.
